definitions.explanation: The act of focusing one's attention or mental effort.
The gathering of things in one place.

notes:
{集中|しゅうちゅう} means concentration - either mental focus or physical centralization.

MEANING 1 - MENTAL FOCUS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}する (to concentrate, to focus)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (can concentrate)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦{力|りょく}→力：noentry⟧ (concentration, ability to focus)

MEANING 2 - CENTRALIZATION:
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう} (concentration of power)
- ⟦{一極|いっきょく}→一極：noentry⟧{集中|しゅうちゅう} (concentration in one place)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧ (localized heavy rain)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧ (concentrated attack)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧ (intensive course)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}⟦{治療室|ちりょうしつ}→治療室：noentry⟧ (ICU - intensive care unit)
